title: Tactical Alert/Galleon of Ghouls/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Dialogue during the Galleon of Ghouls Tactical Alert.
> “A Mutual Enemy
> Tenno, you wretched maggots. My Ghouls have betrayed me. Stolen my galleons and weapon parts. They aim to attack me AND YOU. So... We both have a problem.
> My solution: you. You capture the instigators. Use my favorite instrument of explosive violence: the Ogris. In return, you keep what they stole, and we both crush an enemy.
> Take it or leave it.” —Councilor Vay Hek
DGhoulsWeekOneInbox0010VayHek_en.ogg
> “Motivation!

> Regret not, maggot. The galleon you raided was headed to an Ostron Floating Market near Earth. The Ghouls would have slaughtered every last one of those filthy peasants. And I know that would make you SAD.
> More instigators hide in the shadows. Bring them to me before they become a problem for you.
> For motivation, take this blueprint. It uses parts you will recover while capturing Ghouls.” —Councilor Vay Hek
(Attached items: Tonkkatt Blueprint, Stratos Emblem)
> “Back for more?
> Your hunger for weapons is pathetically reliable. Have another blueprint, you ravenous worm.
> The instigator Ghouls run, but they still scheme. Fill their rotting hearts with regret, and their flesh with shrapnel.” —Councilor Vay Hek
(Attached items: Tak & Lug Blueprint, Stratos Emblem)
> “One Last Chance
> The last of the Ghoul galleons has been located. Your final chance to take what you need. After that our partnership is dust.
> So long, maggots.” —Councilor Vay Hek
(Attached items: Orokin Reactor, Orokin Catalyst, Stratos Emblem)
